# P37.56 — WACZ capture for HTML document sources (BL-026)

- **Spec:** `docs/tickets/483_P37.56__wacz-capture-html-sources.md` (manifest row 483; `R11-TRANS-02`)
- **Base:** `r11/P37.55-archival-deposits` (`b6b15ba1`)
- **Config:** `implement-spec … live_verification=false` — engineering dispatch. The named
  mutation ("the WACZ capture runs for the HTML document sources", OM-20, named verbatim in
  GATE-G6 §4 "Approve all 15 (rec.)" @ `b91f8e58`, expiry next GATE) executes ONLY in the
  `live_verification=true` re-run under the AR-3 + AR-2 window. **No live requests, no captures,
  no production writes, no credentials** in this PR.

## What this changes

The `--wacz` seam existed end-to-end (`cli → run_source → OcflCaptureStore(capture_wacz=)`)
but was **inert**: `_should_capture_wacz` required a `wacz_builder` the runner never
supplied, so the flag produced nothing. This row makes the flag real, declares it per job,
and prepares the gated run leg.

- `connectors/capture_ocfl.py` — `capture_wacz=True` alone now enables the WACZ path: a
  deterministic single-response WACZ 1.1.1 packaged from the fetched bytes via
  `evidence.capture.build_wacz` is the default; the P02.2 Playwright `wacz_builder` seam
  still overrides for rendered captures (§17.4). `put()` gains `status`; the metadata
  sidecar records the response status and the WACZ member's own digest+size;
  `CaptureRef.wacz_digest` binds the availability record to the real member.
- `connectors/stages.py` — the `CaptureStore.put` protocol and `InMemoryCaptureStore`
  accept `headers`/`status`; `Connector.capture` forwards the fetch result's real
  status + headers — the WARC records what was observed, never a fabricated 200.
- `ops/scheduled.py` — `SourceCadence.wacz` / `BatchCadence.wacz`; `scheduled_ingest(wacz=)`
  forwards to the gated runner (gate untouched — still fails closed); `RunRow` gains
  `wacz` + `wacz_captures` (`capture_digest → wacz_digest`), so "enabled, produced none"
  is distinguishable from "disabled" on the WORM audit row.
- `ops/cli.py` — `scheduled-ingest --wacz`.
- `ops/cadence.toml` — `wacz = true` on the 14 html-mode `[[sources]]` (the CCOPS/PATHWAYS/
  OSCN/OKCPD/eyes-on-flock/tribal document pages) and the 6 Round-11 document batches
  carrying HTML members (`r11-disclosures-01/02`, `r11-documents-01`, `r11-tier2-01/02/03`).
  The flag is media-type self-limiting inside the capture store — a mixed batch's non-HTML
  members' output is unchanged.
- `ops/gcp/scheduled-ops.sh` — the readers emit the declaration and the deploy args append
  `--wacz`; job updates preserve the P37.3 evidence-bucket mount, so WACZ members land in
  `evidence/captures/` retention-governed.
- `ops/gcp/wacz-capture.sh` — the gated leg script (`prestate`/`jobs`/`run`/`probe`/
  `verify`/`rollback`): the same 03:00–10:00Z daily exclusion (`exit 42` QUEUED), the
  `SIG_WACZ_AUTHOR` OM-20 arming gate, an OM-18 stop when a job's live args match neither
  the declared nor the wacz shape, and a rollback that restores the recorded args exactly.
  The job set derives from the `wacz = true` declaration — no second list to drift.
- **ADR-247** records the owned decisions (deterministic packager default; `wacz` as a
  cadence declaration; the named job set).
- RETURN PASS row `P37.56` `kind=leg` + one `[[row.legs]]` (`P37.56-wacz-capture`) —
  `prepared_not_executed`; cells compacted to hold the orient recipe under 48 KiB.
